mapper.select: /*selectCommonMpIvDetailInvoiceCreationPopList*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS WMS_NAME, -- 0 A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, -- 1 A.DESCRIPTION, -- 2 A.SPECIFICATION, -- 3 A.UNIT_MEASURE, -- 4 A.ITEM_QTY, -- 5 A.UNIT_PRICE, -- 6 A.ITEM_AMT, -- 7 DECODE(A.IV_QTY,0,A.ITEM_QTY,A.IV_QTY) AS IV_QTY, -- 8 A.RD_DATE, -- 9 A.VPO_REMARK, -- 10 A.BUYER, -- 11 A.VPO_SEQ -- 12 FROM EDIVPODT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.VPO_NO = #{st_vpo_no} AND A.AGENT = #{st_agent} ORDER BY 1,2
